ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The left vertical wire of the circuit is the same node P, and the right vertical wire is the same node Q. At the top there is a 2 A current source, with the arrow pointing from P to Q. The middle upper node is denoted as A; it is connected to P through a 2Ω resistor and to Q through a 4Ω resistor. The middle lower node is denoted as B; it is connected to P through an 8Ω resistor and to Q through a 6Ω resistor. There is a 10 V voltage source between A and B, with the positive sign at the upper end in the figure, so the potential at end A is 10 V higher than that at end B. Reasoning: Let Q be the reference ground, V_Q = 0. From the polarity of the voltage source, V_A - V_B = 10. According to the specified method, write KCL at node P; the top current source is 2 A flowing from P to Q, that is, leaving P: ((V_P - V_A)/2) + ((V_P - V_B)/8) + 2 = 0. Write KCL for the supernode containing A and B: ((V_A - V_P)/2) + (V_A/4) + ((V_B - V_P)/8) + (V_B/6) = 0. After simplification, 5V_P - 4V_A - V_B = -16, 18V_A + 7V_B - 15V_P = 0, and V_A - V_B = 10. Solving gives V_B = -10.8 V, V_A = -0.8 V, V_P = -6 V. Because V_Q = 0, V_P - V_Q = -6 V.

method.method_draft: First describe the diagram to identify all nodes and component polarities. Set Q as ground. Denote the upper central node by A and the lower central node by B. From the image, impose V_A - V_B = 10 V because the vertical source has plus at A. Then write KCL at node P, counting the top current source as 2 A leaving P toward Q, and write KCL for the supernode containing A and B. Solve the resulting three linear equations for V_P. Since Q is the reference, the requested potential difference V_P - V_Q is the solved value, -6 V.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：电路左侧竖直导线为同一节点 P，右侧竖直导线为同一节点 Q。顶部有一个 2 A 电流源，箭头从 P 指向 Q。中间上方节点记为 A，它通过 2Ω 电阻接到 P，通过 4Ω 电阻接到 Q。中间下方节点记为 B，它通过 8Ω 电阻接到 P，通过 6Ω 电阻接到 Q。A 与 B 之间有一个 10 V 电压源，图中正号在上端，因此 A 端电位比 B 端高 10 V。
推理：令 Q 为参考地，V_Q = 0。由电压源极性得 V_A - V_B = 10。按指定方法，在 P 节点列 KCL，顶部电流源为 2 A 从 P 流向 Q，即离开 P：((V_P - V_A)/2) + ((V_P - V_B)/8) + 2 = 0。对包含 A、B 的超节点列 KCL：((V_A - V_P)/2) + (V_A/4) + ((V_B - V_P)/8) + (V_B/6) = 0。整理得 5V_P - 4V_A - V_B = -16，18V_A + 7V_B - 15V_P = 0，且 V_A - V_B = 10。解得 V_B = -10.8 V，V_A = -0.8 V，V_P = -6 V。因为 V_Q = 0，所以 V_P - V_Q = -6 V。
